784-boyhood-in-norway-stories-of-boy-lif.description: A book by Hjalmar Hjorth Boyesen. to invest the war with a breathless and all-absorbing interest. It was now no longer “make believe,” but deadly earnest. Blood had flowed; insults had been exchanged in due order, and offended honor cried for vengeance.

arxiv-2012-10585.title: Local number variances and hyperuniformity of the Heisenberg family of determinantal point processes
arxiv-2012-10585.creator: Takato Matsui, Makoto Katori, Tomoyuki Shirai
arxiv-2012-10585.description: Abstract The bulk scaling limit of eigenvalue distribution on the complex plane ℂ {\mathbb{C}} of the complex Ginibre random matrices provides a determinantal point process (DPP). This point process is a typical example of disordered hyperuniform system characterized by an anomalous suppression of large-scale density fluctuations.

arxiv-2012-11249.title: Zero-cycles on normal projective varieties
arxiv-2012-11249.creator: Mainak Ghosh, Amalendu Krishna
arxiv-2012-11249.description: Abstract 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14C25; Secondary 14F42, 19E15 Abstract. We prove an extension of the Kato-Saito unramified class field theory for smooth projective schemes over a finite field to a class of normal projective schemes. As an application, we obtain Bloch’s formula for the Chow groups of 0-cycles on such schemes.

arxiv-2106-11984.title: Identification of Sagittarius stream members in Angular Momentum space with Gaussian mixture techniques
arxiv-2106-11984.creator: Jorge Peñarrubia, Michael S. Petersen
arxiv-2106-11984.description: Abstract This paper uses Gaussian mixture techniques to dissect the Milky Way (MW) stellar halo in angular momentum space. Application to a catalogue of 5389 stars near the plane of the Sagittarius (Sgr) stream with full 6D phase-space coordinates supplied by Gaia EDR3 and SEGUE returns four independent dynamical components.

arxiv-2202-00282.title: Stabilizing Spiking Neuron Training
arxiv-2202-00282.creator: Luca Herranz-Celotti, Jean Rouat
arxiv-2202-00282.description: Abstract Stability arguments are often used to mitigate the tendency of learning algorithms to have ever increasing activity and weights that hinder generalization. However, stability conditions can clash with the sparsity required to augment the energy efficiency of spiking neurons. Nonetheless it can also provide with solutions.

arxiv-2205-06232.title: Lorentzian wormholes supported by tachyon matter
arxiv-2205-06232.creator: Rikpratik Sengupta a , Shounak Ghosh b , Mehedi Kalam a
arxiv-2205-06232.description: Abstract Wormholes with Ellis geometry have been successfully constructed using tachyon matter [ 1 ] . However, for such a wormhole, it is obtained that the redshift function is necessarily a constant, and also the wormhole is plagued with an imaginary tachyon potential and a constant field if the solutions are obtained in the absence of a cosmological constant term.

arxiv-2306-04544.title: Contrastive Bootstrapping for Label Refinement
arxiv-2306-04544.creator: Shudi Hou, Yu Xia, Muhao Chen, Sujian Li
arxiv-2306-04544.description: Abstract Traditional text classification typically categorizes texts into pre-defined coarse-grained classes, from which the produced models cannot handle the real-world scenario where finer categories emerge periodically for accurate services. In this work, we investigate the setting where fine-grained classification is done only using the annotation of coarse-grained categories and the coarse-to-fine mapping.

arxiv-2412-04768.title: Small Triangulations of 4-Manifolds and the 4-Manifold Census
arxiv-2412-04768.creator: Rhuaidi Burke, Benjamin Burton, Jonathan Spreer
arxiv-2412-04768.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rhuaidi Burke, Benjamin Burton, Jonathan Spreer. We present a framework to classify PL-types of large censuses of triangulated 4 4 -manifolds, which we use to classify the PL-types of all triangulated 4 4 -manifolds with up to six pentachora. This is successful except for triangulations homeomorphic to the 4 4 -sphere, ℂ ​ P 2 \mathbb{C}P^{2} , and the rational homology sphere Q ​ S 4 ​ ( 2 ) QS^{4}(2) , where we find at most four, three, and two PL-types respectively.

pmc-10657428.title: PET/CT based cross-modal deep learning signature to predict occult nodal metastasis in lung cancer
pmc-10657428.creator: Yifan Zhong, Chuang Cai, Tao Chen, Hao Gui, Jiajun Deng, Minglei Yang, Bentong Yu, Yongxiang Song, Tingting Wang, Xiwen Sun, Jingyun Shi, Yangchun Chen, Dong Xie, Chang Chen, Yunlang She
pmc-10657428.description: Occult nodal metastasis (ONM) plays a significant role in comprehensive treatments of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This study aims to develop a deep learning signature based on positron emission tomography/computed tomography to predict ONM of clinical stage N0 NSCLC. An internal cohort (n = 1911) is included to construct the deep learning nodal metastasis signature (DLNMS).

pmc-10748711.title: Patient-related Risk Factors Associated with Poorer Outcomes Following Total Ankle Arthroplasty: A Scoping Review of 101552 Cases
pmc-10748711.creator: Ibrahim Inzarul Haq, Zaki Arshad, Maneesh Bhatia
pmc-10748711.description: Category:Ankle ArthritisIntroduction/Purpose:Total ankle arthroplasty and ankle arthrodesis are both first line options for end stage arthritis. Both have good outcomes in terms of patient reported outcome measures, complications, and revision rate. Despite efforts to determine a superior option, results are inconsistent.

pmc-11620218.title: Relationship between fatigue and quantitative electromyography findings in patients with myasthenia gravis
pmc-11620218.creator: Didem Savaşcı, Metin Mercan, Vildan Yayla
pmc-11620218.description: BackgroundFatigue is a common complaint among patients with myasthenia gravis (MG). In this study, we investigated the alterations in muscle morphology in patients with MG experiencing fatigue using quantitative electromyography (QEMG), and explored the relationship between electrophysiological findings and the severity of both fatigue and disease.

pmc-11691290.title: EXTENDING GERONTOLOGICAL KNOWLEDGE AND THEORY THROUGH ETHNOGRAPHIC CASE STUDY METHODS
pmc-11691290.creator: Amanda Grenier
pmc-11691290.description: Experiences of older people deemed to be ‘at risk or ‘in need’ of intervention are often viewed through professional classifications with corresponding ‘objective’ indices. Concepts such as frailty and mobility, which have come to draw international policy attention, and arguably shape understandings of aging, are also produced within disciplinary knowledge(s) and powerful practices that prioritize particular components over others.

pmc-12469696.title: The Influence of Cohesin on the Short-Scale Dynamics of Intact and Damaged Chromatin in Different Phases of the Cell Cycle
pmc-12469696.creator: Vladimir S Viushkov, Nikolai A Lomov, Polina O Kalitina, Daria M Potashnikova, Anastasia S Shtompel, Sergey V Ulianov, Sergey V Razin, Mikhail A Rubtsov, Stephanie Portillo-Ledesma
pmc-12469696.description: Cohesin organizes the genome into spatially segregated loops and topologically associated domains by loop extrusion. In addition, it ensures cohesion of sister chromatids after replication. Thus, cohesin is expected to limit chromatin dynamics by ensuring cohesion and compacting chromatin in the interphase.

pmc-12693314.title: A Novel Zn-Cu Bimetallic Mixed-Component MOFs Composite for Efficient CO2 Capture
pmc-12693314.creator: Haihong Zhao, Lei Li, Jiaxin Li, Feiqi Yan, Wenhao Wang, Mingxia Zhao
pmc-12693314.description: In this work, a novel mixed-component bimetallic metal–organic framework (MOF) composite material was synthesized via a solvothermal approach, and its structural and textural properties were systematically characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), N2 adsorption/desorption analysis, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

pmc-13450965.title: Adherence to Potassium Citrate, Changes in 24-Hour Stone Risk Parameters, and Recurrent Kidney Stone Events
pmc-13450965.creator: Joseph J. Crivelli, Mary K. Oerline, Naim M. Maalouf, Ryan S. Hsi, Noah A. Krampe, Kevin B. Smith, Sara L. Best, Brian T. Denton, Vahakn B. Shahinian, John M. Hollingsworth
pmc-13450965.description: Visual Abstract Introduction Alkali therapy is recommended for patients with recurrent calcium-based stones and low or relatively low urinary citrate, as well as those with uric acid stones and low urine pH.1 Potassium citrate is the preferred alkali in these settings, which has improved urinary parameters in clinical trials.

pmc-13545036.title: Language network disruption in patients with Lewy body diseases
pmc-13545036.creator: Daniel Carbol, Lubomira Novakova, Patricia Klobusiakova, Irena Rektorova
pmc-13545036.description: Lewy body diseases, including Parkinson’s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies, are marked by neuronal α‑synuclein aggregation, motor parkinsonism, cognitive impairment and diverse non‑motor symptoms including communication impairments. Compared to other symptoms, non‑motor communication impairments remain under-explored, especially outside English‑speaking cohorts.
